collection.title: Ford Ka 2011 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Ka 2011 - 2016 model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 14" passengers side with a the Push Button wiper arm attachment. We also have rear blade blades for this model this can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
